clips.title: The story
paras: Ormer Ironbraid is a dwarven archaeologist stationed at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the southern Wetlands. His team's historical research has been violently interrupted by ravenous raptors that overran the dig. Ormer seeks adventurous allies to clear out the beasts and avenge the miners driven from the site.

Ormer Ironbraid arrived in the Wetlands as part of the dwarven effort to uncover Titan relics and ancient history at Whelgar's Excavation Site. Unfortunately, uncovering ancient stones also unearthed—or at least provoked—packs of fierce Wetlands raptors. Rather than cataloging ancient earthenware and tablets, Ormer spends his days watching the beasts prowl among the ruins, nursing a fierce hatred for the creatures that disrupted their work.

Ormer refuses to abandon the dig, but he lacks the raw muscle to purge the site alone. He directs his frustration into a systematic campaign of extermination, enlisting passing travelers to slay raptors of increasing size and ferocity. For Ormer, reclaiming the excavation is not just about the artifacts—it is a deeply personal matter of dwarven pride and vengeance against the local wildlife.
